title: Benign versus Malignant Soft-Tissue Tumors: Differentiation with 3T Magnetic Resonance Image Textural Analysis Including Diffusion-Weighted Imaging

record.paper_title: Benign versus Malignant Soft-Tissue Tumors: Differentiation with 3T Magnetic Resonance Image Textural Analysis Including Diffusion-Weighted Imaging
record.source_excerpt: In multivariate logistic regression, the mean ADC value (SSF, 6) and kurtosis of CE-T1WI (SSF, 4) were independently associated with malignancy (P ≤ 0.009).
record.modeling_hypothesis: The mean ADC value at spatial-scale factor 6 and kurtosis of CE-T1WI at spatial-scale factor 4 are predictive features for malignancy in soft-tissue tumors.

record.paper_title: Benign versus Malignant Soft-Tissue Tumors: Differentiation with 3T Magnetic Resonance Image Textural Analysis Including Diffusion-Weighted Imaging
record.source_excerpt: A multivariate model of MR features worked well for diagnosis of malignant soft-tissue tumors (AUC, 0.909).
record.modeling_hypothesis: A multivariate model using MR textural features achieves an AUC of 0.909 for diagnosing malignant soft-tissue tumors.
